blocking.title: A war across the sea declared with no lift, through a door the lift gate does not ask (diploInvariants lift broken)
blocking.evidence: npx tsx tools/diag/diploInvariants.ts 64015 random 1825 --heroes: 1 broken, 'day 1411: lift: ARG declared on #105 over the sea, 16294 men to lift for a room of 25200' (critic/c79_diploinv_64015rh.log). D=105 npx tsx critic/scripts/c79_liftTrace.ts 64015 random 1411 ARG --heroes (critic/c79_liftTrace_64015_D2.log): in each of the six hours before, callSides(ARG,#105) = [[ARG],[#105]], the sides touch nowhere and noLift is true; #105 at war with Brazil, Argentina's land neighbour by ownership only; in the declaration's hour Brazil makes peace with #105 and takes it as a puppet. The lift's jump to 84,894 is the war's own effect: at tick 33864 seaLift 16,294 and noLift true, declareWar by hand with no step makes it 84,894 (npx tsx critic/scripts/c79_liftJump.ts, critic/c79_liftJump_64015.log). 0 broken on the other 16 checker runs of new seeds and on 3 of earlier seeds. The sim is run 78's, so run 78's build gives the same.
blocking.fix: Find the door that declared ARG on #105 and ask noLift there (not found by me; one candidate: a test of 'over the sea' by ownership, where neighbourMap has ARG beside #105 while the sides touch nowhere by control), as R145 did for a massing's declaration; or narrow the checker by an ADR if a war on a rebel at war with its holder is meant to be exempt. Seen fixed when the command prints 0 broken, and diploInvariants on ten more random-diplomacy seeds with heroes (five years each) prints 0 broken.
